note: What the buddy (Roco or Rina) says on the menus, in the student's talk language (D-033): en English, fil Filipino, bis Bisaya. {buddy} becomes the buddy's name; %s and %d are filled in by the game. Lessons, hints and answer explanations keep the lesson's own language (MATATAG), so they are not here. Filipino and Bisaya are drafts for a teacher to check.
